title: Georgekutty Is Coming to Your Living Room. Drishyam 3 Hits Prime Video This Wednesday.
excerpt: After a ₹236 crore worldwide run, Mohanlal's franchise closer arrives on streaming — in four languages, across 200+ countries. No more excuses.
body:
Four weeks ago, **Mohanlal** walked back into a role that has defined his last decade. **Drishyam 3**, the final chapter of Indian cinema's most celebrated thriller franchise, tore through theaters like Georgekutty tears through alibis — methodically, ruthlessly, and with a smile that makes you forget he's the one you should be watching.

<youtube></youtube>

The numbers are staggering. ₹236 crore worldwide. The highest-grossing Malayalam film of 2026. The first South Indian film this year to cross $10 million overseas. And now, starting **June 18**, every single one of those crores becomes irrelevant — because the film arrives on **Amazon Prime Video**, and suddenly everyone with a subscription and a screen is invited to the party.

## The Setup

Years have passed since the events of *Drishyam 2*. Georgekutty — the cable TV operator who outwitted an entire police force to protect his family — has done something so audacious it almost feels like a taunt: he turned his own story into a movie. His daughters are older. His wife **Rani** (played once again by **Meena**, who continues to make silence feel louder than dialogue) appears settled. The family business is stable. The bodies are buried, literally and figuratively.

But this is Jeethu Joseph's universe, and peace is just the appetizer.

> "George Kutty is a character who has stayed with audiences for many years, and that love is something I deeply cherish. The reason audiences connect with Drishyam is that, beyond the mystery, it is rooted in a deeply human story about family, love, and survival." — Mohanlal

The threat this time is layered: two journalists begin digging into the real-life inspiration behind Georgekutty's film, pulling at threads he thought were knotted shut. Simultaneously, a seemingly innocent marriage proposal for his eldest daughter **Anju** turns into something far more sinister. Director **Jeethu Joseph** — the man who created this franchise in 2013 and watched it spawn remakes in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada — delivers what critics have called his bravest ending yet.

## Why Diaspora Viewers Should Care

Here's what makes June 18 matter for NRIs: **Drishyam 3** streams globally in its original Malayalam, plus dubbed versions in Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada, across **200+ countries and territories**. If you missed the theatrical run — and many diaspora viewers did, since the Malayalam version had limited screens in North America — this is your moment.

The franchise holds a unique place in Indian cinema's cultural footprint. The 2013 original was a word-of-mouth phenomenon that redefined Malayalam thrillers. *Drishyam 2* arrived in 2021 as a Prime Video premiere during the pandemic and became a streaming sensation that crossed language barriers entirely. The Hindi remakes starring **Ajay Devgn** turned Georgekutty into a household name across the Hindi belt.

This third installment, though, is the one that closes the door. And if you've invested in Georgekutty's journey across any language, any version, any decade — this is the payoff.

## A Word About the Hindi Version

For those keeping track: **Drishyam 3 Hindi** is coming too, but don't expect a carbon copy. Reports confirm that Ajay Devgn's version, also directed by Abhishek Pathak, takes a different narrative path from the Malayalam original. **Jaideep Ahlawat** replaces Akshaye Khanna as the antagonist, and composer **Ravi Basrur** (of *KGF* fame) is scoring the film. That version is slated for later this year.

But the original — Mohanlal's, Jeethu Joseph's, the one that started everything — lands on your screen on Wednesday. If you've ever loved a thriller that respects your intelligence, this is the one.

**Drishyam 3** premieres on **Amazon Prime Video** on **June 18, 2026**.
